verdict.rationale: Anytype documents native iOS and Android apps and sync between desktop and mobile. Community users say the iOS app is well-crafted and that the Apple and Android apps work well. Nothing in the evidence shows the mobile apps offer full feature parity, so whether they are more than a companion is unproven. Missing for 10: documented mobile capture flows, mobile search and linking, an explicit statement of feature parity with desktop, and hands-on reports of power-user mobile workflows.

support.subject: As a power-user, full-featured iOS and Android apps give me my whole knowledge base — capture, search, and linking — not a stripped-down companion

citations.quote: It is available on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android.
If you prefer to fully keep your data on your device without any server to sync between your desktop and mobile, you can enable local-only mode.
